decode_vin.description: Turn a VIN into the vehicle it describes: year, make, model, trim, body, engine, fuel, transmission, where it was built, and its safety equipment. Says whether the VIN is valid and what is wrong with it if not. A partial VIN works too, with * for unknown characters.
decode_vin.name: decode_vin

parameters.description: The vehicle identification number. Spaces, dashes and lower case are fine; use * for a character you don't know.
parameters.name: vin

parameters.description: Optional. A VIN's year letter repeats every 30 years, so giving the year makes an older vehicle decode correctly.
parameters.name: model_year

decode_vins.description: Decode up to 50 VINs in one step, each into the same vehicle details 'Decode VIN' gives. Lists the VINs that are not valid so they can be checked.
decode_vins.name: decode_vins

parameters.description: Up to 50 VINs: a list, or text with one VIN per line or separated by commas.
parameters.name: vins

find_car_seat_inspection_stations.description: Find places where a certified technician will check that a child's car seat is installed correctly, usually for free: the organization, address, phone and email, and the counties they serve. Search a whole state or one ZIP code in it.
find_car_seat_inspection_stations.name: find_car_seat_inspection_stations

parameters.description: The state or territory to search.
parameters.name: state

parameters.description: Only stations in this ZIP code. Leave empty to search the whole state.
parameters.name: zip_code

parameters.description: Only list stations with a technician who speaks Spanish.
parameters.name: spanish_speaking

find_manufacturer.description: Find vehicle and equipment manufacturers registered with NHTSA by name: their registered name and address, country, what they make, and the weight classes of their vehicles.

vehicle_types.name: Passenger Car
vehicle_types.weight_class_from: Class 1A: 3,000 lb or less (1,360 kg or less)

find_manufacturer.name: find_manufacturer

parameters.description: All or part of the manufacturer's name.
parameters.name: name

get_complaint.description: Look up one owner complaint by its NHTSA (ODI) number: what happened, the components involved, whether there was a crash, fire, injury or death, and the vehicles it concerns.

complaint.summary: While driving approximately 35 mph and attempting to accelerate, the vehicle surged forward.

get_complaint.name: get_complaint

parameters.description: The complaint's ODI number, from 'Get complaints for a vehicle' or NHTSA's website.
parameters.name: odi_number

get_recall.description: Look up one recall by its NHTSA campaign number: what is wrong, the risk, the fix, how many vehicles it affects, and every year, make and model it covers.

recall.consequence: Fuel pump failure can cause an engine stall while driving, increasing the risk of a crash.
recall.notes: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236.
recall.remedy: Honda will notify owners, and dealers will replace the fuel pump assembly, free of charge.
recall.summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2019-2020 vehicles. The low-pressure fuel pump inside the fuel tank may fail.

get_recall.name: get_recall

parameters.description: NHTSA's campaign number, written any common way: 19V182000, 19V-182 or 19V182.
parameters.name: campaign_number

get_safety_ratings.description: Get a vehicle's NHTSA 5-Star Safety Ratings: overall, frontal crash, side crash and rollover, with the crash-test photos and videos, its safety technology, and how many recalls, complaints and investigations it has. Pick a version for one body style and drive, or leave it empty to rate every version.
get_safety_ratings.name: get_safety_ratings

parameters.description: The vehicle's model year, from those in NHTSA's crash-test ratings.
parameters.name: year

parameters.description: The manufacturer's brand, for example HONDA.
parameters.name: make

parameters.description: The model, spelled the way NHTSA's crash-test ratings spells it (for example CIVIC SEDAN).
parameters.name: model

parameters.description: The body style and drive, for example '4 DR FWD'. Leave empty to return every rated version.
parameters.name: vehicle_id

get_vehicle_complaints.description: Get the safety complaints owners have filed with NHTSA about a year, make and model, newest first, with totals for crashes, fires, injuries and deaths and the components complained about most. Narrow the list to serious incidents or recent filings.

complaints.summary: While driving approximately 35 mph and attempting to accelerate, the vehicle surged forward.

get_vehicle_complaints.name: get_vehicle_complaints

parameters.description: The vehicle's model year, from those in NHTSA's complaint records.
parameters.name: year

parameters.description: The manufacturer's brand, for example HONDA.
parameters.name: make

parameters.description: The model, spelled the way NHTSA's complaint records spells it (for example CIVIC).
parameters.name: model

parameters.description: Only list complaints that report any of these. Leave empty for every complaint.
parameters.name: involving

parameters.description: Only list complaints filed on or after this date. Leave empty for every date.
parameters.name: filed_on_or_after

parameters.description: How many complaints to return, newest first. Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: limit

get_vehicle_dimensions.description: Get a vehicle's length, width, height, wheelbase, track width, curb weight and front/rear weight split, for each version of the model, in inches and pounds or centimetres and kilograms. Comes from the Canadian Vehicle Specifications NHTSA publishes, which start with 1971 models.
get_vehicle_dimensions.name: get_vehicle_dimensions

parameters.description: The vehicle's model year (1971 or later).
parameters.name: year

parameters.description: The manufacturer's brand, for example Honda.
parameters.name: make

parameters.description: All or part of the model name, for example Civic. Leave empty for every model of the make.
parameters.name: model

parameters.description: The units to measure in.
parameters.name: units

get_vehicle_recalls.description: Find every safety recall for a year, make and model, newest first: the component, what can go wrong, the fix, and whether owners are told not to drive it or to park it outside.

recalls.consequence: Fuel pump failure can cause an engine stall while driving, increasing the risk of a crash.
recalls.notes: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236.
recalls.remedy: Honda will notify owners, and dealers will replace the fuel pump assembly, free of charge.
recalls.summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2019-2020 vehicles. The low-pressure fuel pump inside the fuel tank may fail.

get_vehicle_recalls.name: get_vehicle_recalls

parameters.description: The vehicle's model year, from those in NHTSA's recall records.
parameters.name: year

parameters.description: The manufacturer's brand, for example HONDA.
parameters.name: make

parameters.description: The model, spelled the way NHTSA's recall records spells it (for example CIVIC).
parameters.name: model

parameters.description: Only recalls reported to NHTSA on or after this date. Leave empty for every recall.
parameters.name: reported_on_or_after

get_vin_recalls.description: Find the safety recalls issued for the year, make and model a VIN belongs to, newest first, with what is wrong, the risk and the fix. Flags any recall that says not to drive the vehicle or to park it outside. NHTSA's public data covers the model, not whether this particular vehicle has already been repaired.

recalls.consequence: Fuel pump failure can cause an engine stall while driving, increasing the risk of a crash.
recalls.notes: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236.
recalls.remedy: Honda will notify owners, and dealers will replace the fuel pump assembly, free of charge.
recalls.summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2019-2020 vehicles. The low-pressure fuel pump inside the fuel tank may fail.

get_vin_recalls.name: get_vin_recalls

parameters.description: The 17-character vehicle identification number. Spaces, dashes and lower case are fine.
parameters.name: vin

parameters.description: Only recalls reported to NHTSA on or after this date. Leave empty for every recall.
parameters.name: reported_on_or_after

list_models.description: List the models NHTSA has on record for a make, by vehicle type and optionally model year.
list_models.name: list_models

parameters.description: The kind of vehicle.
parameters.name: vehicle_type

parameters.description: The manufacturer's brand.
parameters.name: make

parameters.description: Only models sold in this year. Leave empty for all.
parameters.name: year

description: Look up U.S. vehicle safety data from NHTSA, the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration: decode VINs, check a vehicle's recalls, read owner complaints, get 5-Star crash-test ratings and dimensions, find manufacturers, and find car seat inspection stations. No account or API key is required.
